<h1>fakir</h1>

[`{fakir}` provides a set of functions to generate random data that can be used for prototyping.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

`{fakir}` contains a set of functions for creating synthetic datasets that mimic real-world data, allowing users to test their code under a variety of different scenarios.
